findings.title: Request body is passed unfiltered to users.update
findings.description: req.body is forwarded wholesale to users.update, so a caller can set privileged fields such as role or emailVerified on its own account (mass assignment / privilege escalation). Pick the allowed fields explicitly (name, avatarUrl) or validate against a schema.
findings.suggestion: Destructure and pass only whitelisted fields, e.g. const { name, avatarUrl } = req.body.
